note: Official statutory rates, checked by hand on the date above. Changed only by Budget/notification, so they are not auto-fetched. Always confirm on ICEGATE for your exact HS code before pricing a deal.

sws_pct_of_bcd.source: Social Welfare Surcharge, Finance Act 2018 s.110; not exempted for 5402 under 11/2018-Customs

aidc_pct.source: AIDC nil for 5402 (11/2021-Customs exempts goods not named)

igst_pct.source: Notification 9/2025-Integrated Tax (Rate), Sch. I S.No. 341, from 22 Sep 2025 (was 12%)

add.source: No anti-dumping duty found in force on POY/FDY. DGTR opened an anti-dumping probe on Polyester Textured Yarn (DTY) from China on 20 Nov 2025 (case 6/57/2025-DGTR); check for final findings.

qco.source: BIS Quality Control Orders on PTA, MEG, POY, FDY and PSF were rescinded on 12 Nov 2025 (S.O. 5129(E)-5140(E)), so imports no longer need BIS certification.
